system.description: Ride and care is placed into the act of fletching arrows for war. Pierce 1, Two-Handed Range: This weapon can fire at a target at extreme range by adding {Dc} to the dice of a ranged attack. Superior Craftsmanship: Adds {Da} to the dice of attacks made while wielding it. If you spend at least 1 fortune point on an attack with the bow, it gains +1 Pierce and the extreme range penalty is reduced.
